method: Only a 2px band adjoining existing transparency (alpha<=4). Green-channel spill is capped against local trusted foreground ratios; red/blue and the interior are unchanged. Teal foreground references are excluded. No watermark treatment, no whole-image blur or AI redraw.
alphaPolicy: At most shrinkPixels times the local 1px alpha gradient; shrink is restricted to 0..0.5 and only pixels with verified green spill. Alpha is never increased.
qaLayout: Rows = sampled frames; left = original matte, right = refined; upper = light background, lower = dark background. Crop is QA only; output frame dimensions are unchanged.
